text:
incident-bot: ALERT: P99 latency regression detected for /v1/streaming/generate in us-west-1. p95 360ms -> 2.1s, p99 1.9s -> 15.6s. Affected pool: gpu-rt-pool-7, model: redwood-7b-q4. Paging on-call: @leila.oncall :rotating_light:

leila.oncall: got it. taking lead. quick status: are we seeing 5xx or just stalls? any recent infra changes?

marta.sre: I'm seeing long token gaps for streaming sessions. spike in SM kernel times and repeated driver retries on 2 nodes: gpu-11-07, gpu-11-09. NVML shows multi-bit ECC count increasing on gpu-11-09. thermal events on gpu-11-07.

sasha.runtime: adding context 1: recent firmware roll fw-1.2.3 and a microcode patch landed to that pool at 21:05UTC. Also kernel-tweaks v3 rolled as a canary to 4 nodes 21:08UTC.

tj-metrics: tail numbers from the dashboard snapshot:```
{ "p95_ms": 2100, "p99_ms": 15600, "streaming_stall_ratio": 0.12, "errored_streams": 27 }
```

marta.sre: pulled syslogs from gpu-11-09:```
[21:11:03] NVML ECC multi-bit error on GPU1
[21:11:04] GPU1: critical temp 104C, thermal throttling engaged
[21:11:05] driver: GPU timeout - workqueue retry
[21:11:06] kernel: process inference-serve[2341] hung on GPU1
```

leila.oncall: immediate plan: 1) cordon + drain gpu-11-09 2) reduce pool scheduling to avoid scheduling new high-seq sessions on gpu-11-07 3) route new traffic to gpu-fallback-2.

ops-bot: ACTION: routing update applied 1: weight(gpu-rt-pool-7)=0.2, weight(gpu-fallback-2)=0.8. spun up +6 fallback nodes.

sasha.runtime: pausing kernel-tweaks v3 rollout to remaining canary nodes:```
rdctl rollout pause kernel-tweaks-v3 --scope=pool:gpu-rt-pool-7
```

marta.sre: draining node:```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-11-09
kubectl drain node/gpu-11-09 --timeout=7m --ignore-daemonsets
rdctl node set-state gpu-11-09 out_of_service
```

infra-team: acknowledged. ordering RMA for GPU on gpu-11-09. ticket INFRA-4999 opened. will liaise with colocation.

leila.oncall: check for customer impact list and severity for comms.

priya-cs: query for affected customers:```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) errors, max(latency) max_lat FROM requests
WHERE region='us-west-1' AND timestamp > 2112467400 AND (latency > 5000 OR status != 200)
GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Results: cust-502 (58), cust-820 (19), cust-999 (4). Most are high latency; ~6 resulted in 502 on retry.

priya-cs: drafting update: "We're investigating elevated latency for streaming generation in us-west-1. Some customers may experience delayed tokens or occasional 502. We're routing traffic to fallback capacity and replacing affected hardware. Next update in 30 minutes." cc: security, legal for high-value accounts.

leila.oncall: mitigation checklist: reduce GPU power cap on pool nodes to limit thermal/power spikes, enable aggressive kv_cache, set conservative seq_limit for that pool. sasha, can you apply quick config?

sasha.runtime: applying temporary limits:```
rdctl config set --pool gpu-rt-pool-7 --power_limit 220
rdctl config set --pool gpu-rt-pool-7 --kv_cache aggressive
rdctl config set --pool gpu-rt-pool-7 --max_seq 8192
```

Note: power limit change pushed via nvidia-smi wrapper, may cause performance drop but reduces thermal excursions.

tj-metrics: after routing and node drain: p95 -> 430ms, p99 -> 920ms, streaming_stall_ratio -> 0.03. residual errors tied to sessions pinned to gpu-11-07 where thermal events persisted.

marta.sre: running extended diagnostics on gpu-11-07 (memtest, stress loop) to confirm flakiness before draining. If memtest shows ECC increments, we'll RMA both GPUs.

infra-team: colocation reports on-site tech available for swap. ETA 6h for physical RMA.

leila.oncall: handoff 1: I'm handing on-call to @marta.sre for the next 6h while I step off. Marta will own customer comms, follow-through on RMA, and ensure p99 < 1s for at least 1 hour before incident close.

marta.sre: taking over on-call. I'll update ticket INFRA-4999 and open post-incident follow-ups: - add thermal preflight in rollout pipeline - auto-cordon when ECC multi-bit > 0 - add high-seq synthetic canary to firmware/driver rollouts.

ops-bot: NOTE: fallback capacity remains active. autoscaler set to conservatively replenish gpu-fallback-2 if utilization > 70%.

priya-cs: sent initial status to impacted customers cust-502 and cust-820. will send follow-up when hardware action scheduled.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=Sev2, status=Partial Mitigation, impacted_customers=[cust-502,cust-820], active_ticket=INFRA-4999.

leila.oncall: follow-ups for postmortem: collect kernel traces from 21:00-21:20UTC, correlate firmware roll events, and add timeline. Also recommend temporary gating of firmware/driver rollouts against thermal telemetry.

marta.sre: acknowledged. creating postmortem stub and action items. closing this thread when RMA complete and p99 stable < 1s for 2 hours.
